title: Smart Assistant for Telecom Business Acceptance Based on the “Hui Xin” Large Language Model
summary: China Telecom reports over 50% fewer key process errors and over 30% better marketing success in an assistant deployed in two service halls.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Hui Xin assistant interprets conversations, retrieves information, and completes forms. The source reports deployment in two service halls, fewer key process errors, better marketing success, and 20–30% of representatives’ time freed for other work. Shorter customer waits and broader accessibility are also described, without separately established outcomes.
purpose: Support service representatives with accurate, lower-effort transactions.
location: Two China Telecom service halls (specific locations unstated)

ratings.reason: Deployment in two China Telecom halls reportedly cut key process error rates by over 50% and improved marketing success by over 30%.
The source reports that representatives gain back 20–30% of their time from form-filling and related work, a concrete task-time benefit.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 9: Smart Assistant for Telecom Business Acceptance Based on the “Hui Xin” Large Language Model

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: Hui Xin improves transactions in two telecom service halls

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
